name: New contributor issue
about: Use this template when you want to onboard a first-time contributor

### I want to help! What should I work on?

Please describe the area you'd like to try (docs, bug fix, feature) and the repository path.

### Steps to get started

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a branch named `fix/what-you-will-do`
3. Open a Pull Request and link this issue

Thanks — I’ll review and help you get unstuck.
